what: Acceptance requires stripping embedded larch:plan from the scope anchor but the plan names no strip algorithm or reuse path
scenario_or_breakage: Step 0 writes feature-description.txt from full issue title+body; a redesign issue can still contain a prior larch:plan block, so reviewers/voters may treat stale plan text as binding scope and the ratchet fix fails
suggested_fix: Specify strip behavior in the plan (reuse design-route.sh MARK_START/MARK_END or design-pause-style awk, or call a small shared helper) and add a harness case with markers in the source body
